answers.label: Appropriateness of the TWG subgroup formula
Why the formula is or is not appropriate
answers.text: The formula suggests marginal emission impact to be calculated for each hour separately. The complexity of these calculations will put significant burden on reporters. In general, the calculations required should be simple enough, otherwise companies or anyone reporting will struggle with dedicating sufficient resource.

answers.label: Secondary effects to consider, and how
answers.text:
The larger impact of adding renewable electricity generation to the grid often materializes only over the long-term. Coal-fired generation, for example, is not as flexible and might therefore only be displaced by renewable generation in the long-term. While the GHG Protocol should provide supporting materials, companies should have freedom in assessing and reporting both primary and secondary impacts on a yearly basis. If companies can still claim emission reduction under the market-based-method for their investments in renewable capacity, irrespective of location or time of the day and year, they may be afforded more flexibility in marginal emission impact reporting.

Through MEI reporting companies, companies will be able to illustrate the additional benefits of their investments which, providing them with extra credit on top of the emission reduction calculated as part of their inventories. As such, marginal emission impact calculations do not need to be overly strict and prescriptive and may leave certain level of freedom to reporters.

answers.label: Why annual or lifetime reporting
answers.text: We would recommend providing both options and making sure it is clearly indicated which approach was taken by the reporting company. There are arguments for both calculation methods, depending on the focus on the calculation and report. As per our reply to question 22, if MEI reporting represents the extra credits and benefits companies may claim for their investments, companies may have certain level of flexibility, provided they clearly explain the methodology applied.
